ticker_news.title: It's Time to Sell Apple Stock. Here's Why.
ticker_news.description: The article argues that it's time to sell Apple stock, as the company's recent gains have been driven by investor speculation rather than actual business performance. The author believes Apple is behind in the AI race and that its iPhone sales have been stagnant, with the stock trading at a premium compared to the broader market.
ticker_news.author: Keithen Drury

ticker_news.title: The Smartest Growth Stock to Buy With $1,000 Right Now
ticker_news.description: Broadcom is making waves in the AI semiconductor market, with its ASIC chips being used by tech giants like Alphabet and Meta Platforms. The company's AI revenue soared 220% in 2024, and it is well-positioned to benefit from the projected $2 trillion in AI data center infrastructure spending over the next few years.
ticker_news.author: Chris Neiger

ticker_news.title: Is IonQ the Top Quantum Computing Stock to Buy Now?
ticker_news.description: The article discusses the recent rise and fall of quantum computing stocks, particularly IonQ, and whether it is still a good investment. It also suggests that investors may be better off investing in tech giants like Nvidia and Alphabet that are also investing in quantum computing.
ticker_news.author: Keithen Drury
